description:
Convert jmap-calendars-client method signatures from &str/&[&str] to &Id/&[Id] and from &str (state) to &State. Remove the Option A scaffolding from JMAP-231o.6 (validate_id_field, validate_ids_field helpers) and the 11 call-site usages \u2014 they become dead code under typed parameters.

Delete the smoke tests asserting on empty-id rejection (calendar_get_empty_id_returns_invalid_argument and family) \u2014 the bug becomes impossible to express because Id::new_validated('') returns Err at the test's input construction site, so the test would fail before reaching the production code.

This child lands FIRST and defines the conventions (parameter naming, error path, doc style) that the other client crates copy.
title: 0.2.0 typed-Id: jmap-calendars-client (reference impl)
